subject: Business Models
title: Local vs Global Network Effects
description: Learn Local vs Global Network Effects in one minute.

hook.text: Facebook is valuable because your friends are on it—not because strangers in Brazil use it too.

buildup.text: Local network effects depend on nearby connections. Global effects scale across the entire user base.

discovery.text: Uber has local effects: more drivers in your city helps you, not drivers in another country.

twist.text: Local effects are easier to attack. A competitor can win city by city without needing global scale.

climax.text: This is why Uber faces 100+ local competitors worldwide. Local effects don't create impenetrable moats.

punchline.text: Global effects lock in forever. Local effects can be picked apart.

quiz.question: Why are local network effects easier to compete against?
options: Competitors can win market by market

details.summary: Local network effects depend on geographic density rather than total platform size, while global network effects benefit from worldwide scale. Ride-sharing has local effects since only nearby drivers matter. Social media has global effects since friends can be anywhere.
details.whyItMatters: The local versus global distinction determines whether a market tips to a single winner or supports regional competitors. Local network effects allow niche and regional platforms to thrive alongside global giants.
takeaways: Local effects depend on nearby users; global effects benefit from total scale
Markets with local effects support multiple regional competitors
Markets with global effects tend toward winner-take-all concentration

faq.question: Why can Uber and Lyft coexist in ride-sharing?
faq.answer: Ride-sharing has local network effects because only drivers within minutes matter. Neither company's global scale provides an advantage in a specific city. Both can achieve sufficient local density to deliver good service, and drivers easily multi-home between them.

faq.question: Which types of platforms benefit most from global network effects?
faq.answer: Communication platforms like WhatsApp, social networks like Facebook, and knowledge platforms like Wikipedia benefit most because every user worldwide potentially increases value for every other user regardless of location.
